round1.reason: acceptance-bound policy requires explicit depth-0 authority for every non-exact finding

seats.findings:
🟠 [coupon-pct-lower-bound] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:4 clamps pct with Math.max(1, pct), but the contract limits pct to 0..100; pct=0 becomes 1, so couponCents(subtotal, 0) returns Math.round(subtotal/100) instead of 0, and checkoutTotal inherits the spurious discount; change Math.max(1, pct) to Math.max(0, pct)
🟠 [ship-zero-weight] MUST-FIX src/ship.js:4 only returns 0 for weightG < 0, so shippingCents(0) falls through to 500 + 0 = 500 while the contract requires 0 for weight 0; checkoutTotal(…, 0) is therefore 500 cents too high; change the guard to weightG <= 0

🟠 [coupon-pct-floor-one] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:4 — the clamp `Math.max(1, pct)` uses lower bound 1, but the contract limits pct to 0..100, so a valid pct=0 returns Math.round(subtotal/100) instead of 0 (e.g. couponCents(1000,0) → 10), and src/checkout.js:6 inherits the wrong discount through `couponCents(subtotal, pct)`; smallest remediation: change to `Math.max(0, pct)`.
🟠 [ship-weight-zero-500] MUST-FIX src/ship.js:4 — the guard is `weightG < 0`, so weightG=0 falls through to `500 + Math.ceil(0/500)*100` = 500, but the contract requires shippingCents(0) === 0; src/checkout.js:8 inherits the bug (weight-0 orders overcharged 500 cents); smallest remediation: `if (weightG <= 0) return 0;`.
🔵 [split-n-domain-guard] CUT/FOLLOW-UP src/split.js:4 — splitCents with n<=0 produces [] or relies on division by zero; that input is outside the stated contract, so an explicit guard/throw is optional hardening excluded from this version.

🟠 [coupon-lower-bound] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:4 — the spec requires pct limited to 0..100, but the code clamps the lower bound to 1 (`Math.max(1, pct)`), so a 0% coupon incorrectly produces a 1% discount. Replace `Math.max(1, pct)` with `Math.max(0, pct)`.
🟠 [ship-zero-weight] MUST-FIX src/ship.js:4 — the spec requires shippingCents to return 0 for weight 0, but the guard is `weightG < 0` so weight 0 falls through and returns 500. Change the condition to `weightG <= 0` (or `weightG === 0`) to return 0 as specified.
